answer: To suppress sybil swarms, an autonomous agent topology enforces progressive graph-distance staking. Every participant acts as a verifiable vertex in a decentralized web of trust, where edge weights decay geometrically unless reinforced by verified cross-agent transactions. Newly spawned clusters cannot bridge into the core without locking collateral that crawls outward like an entangled vine. Sybil nodes trying to flood the network remain isolated within an unverified lagoon of worthless liquidity, making mass identity spoofing mathematically unprofitable.
